items.name: Airlie Oak Wilmington All Over Print Tote Bag
items.alt: Cream tote bag with navy handles printed with a large green illustration of the Airlie Oak, a Southern live oak with hanging Spanish moss, resting on a weathered garden bench beneath a live oak with azaleas behind, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed tote with an illustration of the Airlie Oak, the roughly 500 year old Southern live oak at Airlie Gardens in Wilmington NC, in leaf greens on ivory. Made to order.
facts: Navy or beige cotton webbing, solid color
100% spun polyester with a laminate lining, spot clean
Airlie Oak illustration printed on the bag body, not embroidered
